title: A Few New Readings
body:
A few readings are beginning to settle into place.

What they are watching—and where they will end up—can stay unclear for now.

[video: A silent locked-camera showcase of five in-world gauges for vehicle speed, magnetic heading, analog time, fuel level, and heart rate.](../media/code-review-simulator-2026-07-15-a-few-new-readings/gauge-hero-devlog.mp4)
